title: Nobody called for help
text: In 1964 a young woman named Kitty Genovese was attacked outside her New York apartment building, and an early report claimed that thirty-eight neighbours watched and did nothing. The details were {{1}} — few actually saw anything clearly — but the story haunted psychologists because it fitted an uncomfortable pattern. In classic experiments, an actor {{2}} to have a seizure is less likely to be helped the more witnesses there are: with four bystanders present, each individual helps {{3}} than when alone. The {{4}}, researchers argue, is diffusion of responsibility — if many people can act, no one person feels obliged — together with pluralistic ignorance: we glance at each other for a cue, everyone's frozen face {{5}} that nothing serious is happening, and nobody moves. The lesson is not that people are cruel; most bystanders are simply {{6}} by uncertainty. Emergency experts draw a practical {{7}}: in a crowd, do not appeal to everyone. Point at one person, describe them — 'you, in the green coat' — and the same psychology that {{8}} help now delivers it.

gaps.explanation: 'the details were exaggerated' — overstated; exasperate = irritate, aggravate = make worse, evaporate = vanish.
'an actor pretending to have a seizure' — the actor plays at it; precede = come before, proceed = continue.
'each individual helps less' — a smaller amount of helping, which is degree: 'less'. 'Fewer' counts nouns, and 'lesser' is not used here.
'The cause is diffusion of responsibility' — what produces the effect; clause = part of a sentence or contract, counsel = advice.
'a frozen face suggests that nothing is happening' — conveys the impression; digest = process food or information, congest = block up.
'bystanders are simply paralysed by uncertainty' — rendered unable to act; pampered = overindulged, perturbed = worried but still capable.
'draw a practical conclusion' — the fixed collocation with 'draw'; concession = a yielding, congestion = blockage.
'the psychology that blocked help now delivers it' — obstructed it; bank on = rely on, blank out = erase from memory.
